model_annotation: The plot illustrates the import, export, and balance values in billion US dollars from 2020 to 2023. The x-axis represents time, with a linear scale, ranging from 2020 to 2023, and is labeled with tick marks at every half year. The left y-axis represents the import and export values, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 400 billion US dollars, and is labeled with tick marks at every 50 billion US dollars. The right y-axis represents the balance values, with a linear scale, ranging from -200 to 0 billion US dollars, and is labeled with tick marks at every 50 billion US dollars. The blue line, representing imports, starts at approximately 175 billion US dollars in 2020, dips to around 150 billion US dollars, then rises to about 275 billion US dollars in 2022, before fluctuating and ending at around 320 billion US dollars in 2023. The purple line, representing exports, begins at approximately 100 billion US dollars in 2020, increases to around 175 billion US dollars in 2021, and then remains relatively stable, ending at around 170 billion US dollars in 2023. The blue bars, representing the balance, start at around -75 billion US dollars in 2020, and generally remain negative, with some fluctuations, ending at around -150 billion US dollars in 2023.
